content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment is 16 September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Tech degree in Water Resources, Hydrology, or Environmental Engineering from a recognized university to be eligible for the Project Associate-II position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 35,000/- + HRA per month if NET/GATE qualified, or Rs. 28,000/- + HRA per month for others.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II position in the CSIR NEERI recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II post will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The position of Project Associate-II is offered on a contractual basis.
